verdict.rationale: Namecheap is a registrar and hosting service that holds customer data, so an AI-training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair privacy-posture question. The pack has no evidence of any AI-training opt-out or policy. WHOIS privacy (Withheld for Privacy) and a community remark about not sharing info are adjacent privacy features, not controls over AI-model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
